{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lynik''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of vicious predators. They had the ability to predict their prey's moves once they had tasted its [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. They were purple with yellow stripes. On Toydaria, they were raised for combat and pitted against each other in brutal cagefights.
